outcome.technical: CAUSE (reproduced, then established). Reproduction: a scratch repo at the parent of the P131.11 commit with that commit's three files laid over, `stamp-verification.py red --manifest docs/audit/audit-plan.json --task P131.11 -- python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/release.py tools/check-example-pins.py` read could-not-prove with 'with the working tree's implementation the task's tests do not all pass (no tally or error reader matched its output ...)'. The same sweep run directly in that tree printed only per-file 'ok' lines and the summary '2/2 files ok, 67 cases', exit 0; `_runner_output.read_run_tally` on that text returned None. So the reader that rejects the fix-side output is `fix_problem` (via `read_run_tally`): the sweep drops a green file's own output, so a passing sweep carries NO runner tally, only its own summary, which no reader read. Not the environment (the isolated run exits 0, 9.7s total) and not the time budget (nothing timed out). A SECOND blocker sat behind the first, hidden because fix_problem short-circuits before credit: the failing cases were located in the one script the command ran, which for a sweep is tools/sweep-selftests.py, not the suite, so every case read 'the runner locates it in no declared test file' (seen in the swc1 fixture after fixing the first), and the sweep's own two-space 'FAIL  <path>: <why>' lines were counted as failing house cases. FIX. _runner_output.py: `sweep_tally` (a sweep that graded every file ok, at least one file and one case; read_run_tally falls back to it LAST, behind every runner), `sweep_failing_cases` (house cases read per '--- path: why ---' block, each tagged with `script`), and `_house_cases` no longer reads the sweep's two-space FAIL lines. stamp-verification.py: `_failing_cases` (uses the per-file reader for a sweep-shaped command), `case_site` locates a house case at its block's script, `fix_problem` names the failing file ('the sweep failed tests/x.py (exited 1)'), `_TALLY_KEYS` row for the sweep, and the time budget: `sweep_suites`, `load_sweep_costs`, `sweep_budget`, `budget_clause` - for a command running tools/sweep-selftests.py over named suites, the recorded slot-seconds of those suites (read from .github/sweep-costs.json of the project, rounded up, never more than half the deadline) are held back from the baseline/task/held/second runs (`early` deadline) so the fix run keeps them; a suite with no recorded cost holds nothing and is named ('no recorded cost for X'); an unreadable table says why; the basis carries the clause. tools/sweep-selftests.py was NOT touched (its output shape was sufficient). EVIDENCE. Filed P131.11 case, re-run with its own command on the fixed helper in the scratch repo: status proved ('3 of 43 collected tests failing an assertion ... x5, x6, rl16 ... each passing with the working tree's implementation ... fix run: held back 3s of the deadline, the recorded slot-seconds of tools/check-example-pins.py in .github/sweep-costs.json; no recorded cost for tools/release.py') in 10.5s. Cases: swc1-swc9 in tests/test_stamp_verification.py (new stage swc-block, 9/9), rs3 and rs4 in tests/test__runner_output.py (22/22).
